body:
## 1. Objective

Harden persistence and binary artifact boundaries so append-only semantics, checkpoint durability, schema validation, and V82 artifact integrity hold in release builds and under interruption.

## 2. Owning authority

- D-080 ledger format
- D-121 memmap/binary persistence
- D-122 checkpoint/resume
- LEDGER_FORMAT_SPEC §§3-8
- candidate lifecycle and cashflow contracts
- Constitution Rule 5 verifiable artifacts

## 3. Change class

CORRECTNESS_SEMANTICS / CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION

## 4. Current state

Observed risks include:

- CandidateRegistry.append_jsonl writes the complete in-memory record set on each call, allowing duplicate append.
- CashflowLedger.write_jsonl truncates and rewrites a file despite append-only wording.
- Checkpoint save writes a temporary file and renames it without explicit file/directory durability handling.
- V82 artifact string dictionaries cast IDs to u16 without overflow rejection.
- Artifact row-shape checks rely on debug_assert and can disappear in release builds.

## 5. Required end state

- Append operations write only the intended new records.
- Append-only ledgers are durable and idempotent.
- Checkpoints are crash-safe and version/tape-hash validated.
- Artifact schema and row counts are validated in release builds.
- Dictionary overflow and malformed columns fail before bytes are published.
- No partial artifact is treated as valid.

## 6. Expected file / module surface

- v8-core/src/candidate.rs
- v8-core/src/cashflow.rs
- v8-core/src/checkpoint.rs
- v8-core/src/evidence.rs
- v8-core/src/error.rs
- related tests and full-audit readers

## 7. Verification gates

- Repeated append idempotence tests.
- Interrupted checkpoint/write tests.
- Release-mode malformed-row and dictionary-overflow tests.
- Round-trip and truncated-artifact tests.
- Version/tape-hash mismatch tests.
- Byte-stability tests across repeated writes.
- cargo test --release, clippy, ledger-check, and full audit.

## 8. Required evidence artifacts

- Durability/recovery test log.
- Artifact schema validation receipt.
- Append-only ledger replay receipt.
- Checkpoint version/tape-hash verification receipt.
- Updated changelog if contract behavior changes.

## 9. Non-goals / forbidden scope

- No change to f64 encoding or f64 authority.
- No replacement of the V82 ontology without a registered decision.
- No weakening of release-mode validation.
- No economic policy or strategy change.

## 11. Normative traceability

R1 — Append-only ledgers replay deterministically without duplicate publication.
Authority: candidate lifecycle contract; VENUE_AND_CAPITAL_SIMULATION_SPEC §7.

R2 — Checkpoints resume only against the matching version and tape identity.
Authority: D-122; PERSISTENCE_REPLAY_SPEC §4.

R3 — Artifact files are self-describing, rectangular, validated, and byte-stable.
Authority: LEDGER_FORMAT_SPEC §§3-8; D-080.

## 12. Existing types / interfaces to reuse

- CandidateRegistry and TransitionRecord.
- CashflowLedger and EconomicCashflow.
- SimulationCheckpoint and CheckpointHeader.
- Artifact, Column, ArtifactTier, FieldTier, RunConstants.
- V8CoreError checkpoint/serialization/IO variants.

## 13. Mathematical / semantic invariants

- Replay of an append-only ledger is idempotent.
- Every published artifact has rectangular columns and valid counts.
- f64 bytes remain IEEE-754 little-endian.
- Checkpoint tape hash/version must match before resume.

## 14. Canonical failure semantics

- Duplicate/conflicting event: invalid transition / BLOCKED.
- Truncated artifact: Serialization error / CLAIM_BLOCKED.
- Dictionary overflow: Serialization error.
- Checkpoint mismatch: Checkpoint error / BLOCKED.
- Interrupted write: temporary/unpublished state only.

## 15. Dependency map

Domain record -> append/checkpoint/artifact writer -> durable bytes -> replay/read-back validator -> audit receipt.

## 16. OPEN_PIN triggers

- Existing append-only semantics conflict with current rewrite behavior.
- Filesystem durability guarantees differ across supported targets.
- A new artifact format is proposed instead of hardening V82LDRG1.

## V8 guards

- No f64 demotion.
- No fake artifact references.
- No release-only validation gap.
- No unrelated refactor bundled.
